svg.title: Wall time against the fastest other tool
svg.desc: Horizontal bars of median wall time, scrutate against the fastest other tool; the faster bar of each pair is marked with a highlighter. Linux kernel tree, literal: scrutate 581 ms, ugrep 711 ms; Linux tree, complex regex: scrutate 616 ms, ugrep 764 ms; Linux tree, 1.3 million matches: scrutate 630 ms, ripgrep 1,146 ms; One 740 MB file, literal: scrutate 40.0 ms, ugrep 87.4 ms; 200,000 small files, literal: scrutate 962 ms, ugrep 1,304 ms; Linux tree, structural query, capture cache: scrutate 943 ms, ast-grep 13,419 ms. Start-up in a directory with one file: scrutate 3.0 ms, GNU grep 2.7 ms.
svg.text: // 04 LOWER IS BETTER // EACH ROW HAS ITS OWN SCALE
MARKED: THE FASTER OF THE TWO
